f.re: On the territory of the natural monument, any activity that entails a violation of the preservation of the natural monument is prohibited, including: 1. carrying out any activity during the period from May 20 to August 20, entailing disturbance of the rest of colonial nesting birds; 2. destruction of bird nests; 3. all types of fishing; 4. coastline destruction, excavation; 5. movement of all types of transport.
f.rn: Decree of the Government of the Sakhalin Region dated September 7, 2020 No. 419
